cards.explanation: The answer is gladness, friends. The psalm says, "Serve the LORD with gladness…" (Psalm 100:2). Service in this psalm isn't a chore you grit your teeth through. It comes with joyful songs right alongside it.

The answer is False, friends. Nothing here says to slip in quietly. The text says, "come into His presence with joyful songs." (Psalm 100:2). It opens the whole psalm the same way with "Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth." (Psalm 100:1).
The answer is the LORD, friends. The psalm says, "It is He who made us, and we are His…" (Psalm 100:3). The One we're told to know as God is the One who made us. Nobody else gets the credit.
The answer is True, friends. The psalm says, "It is He who made us, and we are His…" (Psalm 100:3). Made by Him and belonging to Him, both in one verse. It goes on to say "we are His people…"

The answer is sheep, friends! The psalm says, "we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture." (Psalm 100:3). It's a picture of belonging, with us as the ones in His pasture. I think it's a gentle picture.

The answer is thanksgiving and praise, friends. The psalm says, "Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise…" (Psalm 100:4). That's what you carry through the gate, a grateful heart and a song.

The answer is True, friends. The verse ends, "give thanks to Him and bless His name." (Psalm 100:4). Thanks and blessing go together at the close of that verse. So the psalm does tell people to bless the LORD's name.

The reason is that the LORD is good, friends. The psalm says, "For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever…" (Psalm 100:5). All that noise and gladness and thanks comes from who He is.

The answer is forever, friends! The psalm says, "…His loving devotion endures forever…" (Psalm 100:5). No expiration date, no best-by sticker. That's good news for a stamper who once had a price sticker of 25 cents.
The answer is False, friends. The psalm says, "His faithfulness continues to all generations." (Psalm 100:5). That's not one generation, that's all of them, one after another.
